title: Easier walking among cut trees
changes: Tree stumps and dead trunks now only block their trunk, so heroes and monsters can walk close past them and slip between a stump and a tree.
Heroes no longer snag on the edge of a stump, tree or rock corner: they slide round it when the way is clear just beside.
Click-to-walk finds shorter, smoother routes through the Cinder Scar, Stormbreak Crags, Blightmire Fen and other places full of cut trees.
